notes.title: aerofly RC 10 Version 10.01.05.09 ( 2024-10-28 )
notes.content:
This is a minor update that fixes the following:

- In low water quality, the white reflections have been fixed
- When restarting aerofly RC 10 in VR mode, the previous start position is now restored

notes.title: aerofly RC 10 Version 10.01.05.05 ( 2024-09-10 )
notes.content: - This update introduces many new languages and fixes a bug during multiplayer when changing the volume of voice chat

notes.title: aerofly RC 10 - Version 10.00.01.16 ( 2024-02-14 )
notes.content: - Experimental voicechat support ( Windows only for now )

notes.content:

notes.title: aerofly RC 10 Version 10.00.01.11 ( 2023-11-10 )
notes.content:
Dear aerofly RC users,

- this update fixes an issue multiplayer issue that the initial player cannot select the scenery

notes.title: aerofly RC 10 Version 10.00.01.07 ( 2023-11-06 )
notes.content:
Dear aerofly RC 10 users,

this update fixes the following issues:

- Fixed an issue with the Velox revolution not flying properly
- Fixed an issue with using the Veloxity model in two player split screen mode
- Fixed an issue with dynamic aircraft lights not working in VR

notes.title: aerofly RC 10 Version 10.00.01.05 ( 2023-11-03 )
notes.content:
Dear aerofly RC 10 users,

this update fixes the following issues:

- Some 3rd party USB radio adapters were recognized as a normal gamepad, this should be fixed now
- The mode switch when displaying the radio sticks is now working properly
- Adjustments to a few models
